name: Spy's Report
summary: Marg Nighteye’s Spy’s Report is an orc spy’s writing found near Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh. Captain Garran Vimes at Theramore is asked to read it because he knows Orcish.

sections.title: A Buried Report
sections.body: Near Witch Hill, loose dirt beside Swamplight Manor hides a report written by Marg Nighteye. The writing is tied to orc spies near Theramore, and Captain Garran Vimes is asked to examine it. He knows Orcish better than most in Theramore.

faq.answer: Marg Nighteye wrote the Spy’s Report.
The Spy’s Report was buried in loose dirt beside Swamplight Manor at Witch Hill in Dustwallow Marsh.
Captain Garran Vimes at Theramore Isle should read the report because he knows Orcish better than most.
The report is an orc spy’s writing and may tell Captain Garran Vimes about Horde spies near Theramore.

angles.text: The report warns of Horde spies near Theramore, an Alliance settlement on Dustwallow Marsh’s coast.
